profile.event_focus: A humorous mismatch between an utterance or event and shared background knowledge or expectations.
profile.trigger_event: A recognizable clash with what would normally be expected becomes available and is construable as witty, rewarding, or pleasantly funny.
profile.laughter_action: Display appreciation and enjoyment of the incongruity, potentially inviting shared amusement.
profile.lexical_anchor: Optional: wording or a described event that makes the humorous mismatch recoverable.

results.situation: Two friends are leaving a crowded supermarket parking lot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [matter-of-fact] My GPS just told me to turn around because I had reached my emotional destination in the supermarket car park.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [amused] [laughs] Apparently it knows you came here for snacks and personal growth.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [playful] I did buy chocolate, so maybe it is not entirely wrong.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [warm] Then let us not argue with a navigation system that believes in you.

profile.event_focus: A mismatch in what has been said or described relative to shared expectations.
profile.trigger_event: An utterance or described situation contains a recognizable incongruity that can be pointed out.
profile.laughter_action: Meta-communicatively flag the incongruity and add the laugher's stance toward it, without necessarily displaying enjoyment.
profile.lexical_anchor: Usually context-level: wording or described content that makes the mismatch identifiable; no special phrase is required.

results.situation: Two coworkers discuss a confusing gym email.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [matter-of-fact] The gym is closed for renovations, but they emailed me a reminder for tomorrow's workout.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [dry] [chuckles] So they're making sure you remember not to come?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [bemused] Apparently my absence is now part of the schedule.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [light] At least their reminders are reliable.

profile.event_focus: The speaker's own socially delicate contribution, such as criticism, dissent, refusal, an inconvenient answer, or painful self-disclosure.
profile.trigger_event: The speaker produces an utterance that carries interpersonal or face cost.
profile.laughter_action: Reduce the force, seriousness, or intrusiveness of the delicate contribution and help manage the uneasiness around it.
profile.lexical_anchor: Action-level: the turn must actually contain the delicate act, such as mild fault-finding, disagreement, refusal, inconvenient information, or trouble-telling.

results.situation: Two coworkers are reviewing a presentation before a client meeting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [hopeful] Could you tell me honestly what you think of my slides?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [hesitant] [awkward chuckles] I think the opening is a little confusing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [thoughtful] Okay, which part loses you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [gentle] The chart appears before you explain what the numbers measure.

profile.event_focus: The speaker's own request, suggestion, opinion, favor, or other contribution that is exposed to evaluation, disagreement, or refusal.
profile.trigger_event: The speaker makes a contribution for which friendly agreement, leniency, or non-harsh evaluation is interactionally relevant.
profile.laughter_action: Solicit goodwill, agreement, friendliness, or leniency from the interlocutor and discourage harsh evaluation of the contribution.
profile.lexical_anchor: Action-level: a request, suggestion, opinion, favor, admission, or similarly evaluable contribution; no particular word is required.

results.situation: A asks B for a small favor after admitting a mildly inconvenient mistake.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [sheepish] Could you cover my shift on Friday, [warm] [chuckles] since I accidentally booked my dentist appointment in the middle of it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [reassuring] Sure, I can take it if you swap with me next week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [relieved] Absolutely, and I owe you coffee too.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [light] Deal, but make it a large one.

profile.event_focus: Mild social or conversational awkwardness in the interaction itself.
profile.trigger_event: Embarrassment, a socially awkward moment, or an unexpected conversational response creates potential discomfort or disrupts the expected flow.
profile.laughter_action: Minimize the awkwardness and help the conversation continue smoothly.
profile.lexical_anchor: None required: the relevant cue may come from the interactional situation rather than a particular expression.

results.situation: Two friends talk after one of them gives an awkward compliment.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [casual] Did you tell Maya that her new haircut looks nice?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [hesitant] I said it was bold, and then she got very quiet.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [awkward] [chuckles] Maybe she heard adventurous, so you could send her a sweet text tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [relieved] Good idea, I will tell her it really suits her.

profile.event_focus: The partner's socially uncomfortable, face-sensitive, or vulnerable contribution.
profile.trigger_event: The partner displays social discomfort or produces a socially incongruous act, such as softening, benevolence induction, smoothing, or another vulnerable contribution.
profile.laughter_action: Show understanding of the partner's discomfort, display closeness, and reassure the partner that they are not being judged harshly.
profile.lexical_anchor: None required: the laughter responds to the partner's social display or discomfort.

results.situation: A admits to an awkward mistake at a neighborhood café.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [sheepish] I waved enthusiastically at someone in the café before realizing they were waving at the person behind me.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [sympathetic] [chuckles] Oh, that happens to everyone, and I promise nobody thought less of you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [relieved] I immediately pretended I was stretching my arm.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [warm] That was a perfectly reasonable recovery plan.

profile.event_focus: The speaker's own proposition or evaluative stance whose literal interpretation differs from the intended ironic meaning.
profile.trigger_event: The speaker produces, or is about to produce, wording whose literal reading conflicts with the contextually intended stance.
profile.laughter_action: Signal that the utterance should not be taken literally but interpreted ironically, indirectly conveying or masking the speaker's real opinion.
profile.lexical_anchor: Required: an expression or proposition whose literal interpretation can plausibly contrast with the intended stance.

results.situation: Two neighbors are moving boxes into a building when the elevator stops working.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [weary] The elevator has been stuck between floors for twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [concerned] And the sofa is still waiting in the lobby.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [dry] [chuckles] Well, this is exactly the swift, stress-free move I dreamed of.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [resigned] Let’s find the stairs before the rain starts.

profile.event_focus: A particular word or phrase whose standard interpretation is not quite the locally intended one.
profile.trigger_event: The speaker uses an expression for which the context supports a richer, loosened, narrowed, or otherwise nonstandard interpretation.
profile.laughter_action: Flag the expression as requiring enrichment or reinterpretation beyond its most standard meaning.
profile.lexical_anchor: Required: a specific word or phrase that can support both a standard interpretation and a contextually enriched one.

results.situation: Two roommates are discussing missed kitchen cleanup duties.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [concerned] Three people skipped their kitchen cleanup this week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [knowing] I’ll send them a “friendly reminder” [chuckles] before dinner.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [firm] Make sure they know the chore chart still applies.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [matter-of-fact] I’ll attach a photo of the overflowing sink.

profile.event_focus: The speaker's own wording or formulation rather than the external event being described.
profile.trigger_event: The speaker treats a just-produced word or phrase as imprecise, excessive, ambiguous, or otherwise in need of reformulation, hedging, qualification, or correction.
profile.laughter_action: Mark the formulation as provisional and manage an ongoing self-repair or editing process.
profile.lexical_anchor: Required: a provisional word or phrase plus an adjacent reformulation, qualifier, hedge, or correction that makes the editing relation recoverable.

results.situation: Two neighbors are comparing homemade jam at a community picnic.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [curious] Did your strawberry jam set properly this time?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [pleased] It did, although I used less sugar than the recipe said.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [thoughtful] Mine is [uncertain] [chuckles] a little runny—well, more like softly spreadable.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [reassuring] That sounds perfect for putting on warm toast.

profile.event_focus: A positive affiliative moment, supportive action, or the relationship/closeness between the participants rather than an incongruity.
profile.trigger_event: The interaction contains support, gratitude, friendliness, shared warmth, or another positively affiliative act.
profile.laughter_action: Display closeness, friendliness, warmth, or positive appreciation of the partner or the shared affiliative moment.
profile.lexical_anchor: None required: the affiliative force may come from the social action or shared moment rather than specific wording.

results.situation: Two friends unwind after one of them has had a difficult workday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [gentle] I made tea before you arrived because I knew today was a lot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [warm] [chuckles] You always seem to know exactly what I need.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [softly] Sit down and tell me whatever you want to share.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: [grateful] Thanks, being here already makes me feel better.
